title: Nuffield Farming Scholarship
amount_raw: A bursary of £9,000 will be given towards the Scholars study tour and subsistence expenses
eligibility_summary: Applicants must work within (or be able to influence) the farming, food, horticultural, forestry, rural and associated industries; aged 25-45 (upper limit 45 on 31 July of application year); resident in the UK holding a UK passport or working directly for UK agriculture; well-established in career and three years post tertiary education. No academic qualifications required. Scholarships are NOT awarded to anyone in full-time education or to further research projects.
summary: The core Nuffield Farming Scholarship: ~25 awarded/year, a £9,000 bursary plus fully-funded professional/leadership development, for a self-directed study tour (min 8 weeks) anywhere in the world on a chosen topic in farming/food/horticulture/forestry/rural industry, followed by a written report and conference presentation.
notes: Deadline from apply-now + essential-information + application-process pages: 'Applications for the 2027 Nuffield Farming Scholarships are now open. Application deadline is at Midday on Thursday 30th July 2026' -> status=open, 2026-07-30 is future vs 2026-08-21 snapshot... FLAG FOR REVIEW: the 30 Jul 2026 deadline is actually PAST relative to the 2026-08-21 snapshot date. The pages still say 'now open'/'deadline 30 July 2026' (not yet updated for the next cycle). This is a recently_closed / stale-open case: the stated deadline has passed but the site presents it as open. Human should decide open (site text) vs recently_closed (date logic). AMBIGUOUS_ELIGIBILITY: scheme funds practitioners' study travel and explicitly states 'Scholarships are not awarded to anyone in full-time education or to further research projects' - tension with the 'available to some UK-based researchers' inclusion test. A UK researcher employed in/influencing the sector could be eligible, but the scheme excludes research projects; kept in_scope=yes but flagged. Amount is a fixed £9,000 study-tour bursary (further professional development funded separately, not costed). Eligibility read from essential-information page; timeline from application-process page (Jan open / 31 Jul close).

title: Nuffield Farming Next-Gen Scholarships
eligibility_summary: Aimed at young people aged 18-24 in the UK with a demonstrable interest in the relevant study group (e.g. dairy, regenerative agriculture, pig); links successful applicants to farmers via the Nuffield Scholar network. UK applicants.
summary: A fully-funded 30-day study programme (all travel/subsistence, plus a £1,000 replacement-labour incentive and Nuffield Associate membership) developing young talent in agriculture; rolled out across study groups (2027 plans three dairy + three pig). 2027 applications open November 2026.
notes: status=forthcoming: 'The 2027 Next-Gen applications will be open in November 2026' (future opening stated -> in scope per inclusion rule). CONFLICTING DEADLINE DATES on the page for the 2027 cycle: 'Applications open in November 2026 and will close on 25 February 2027' in one paragraph vs 'The deadline for applications is the 31st January 2027' in the How to Apply section - both recorded (multi value) with deadlines flagged uncertain. next_open_date 2026-11 (month only). AMBIGUOUS_ELIGIBILITY: aimed at young industry entrants aged 18-24, not academic researchers; a UK-based researcher would generally not qualify - borderline against 'available to some UK-based researchers'. The 2026 cycle (open 1 Nov 2025, close 31 Jan 2026, 6 awarded) is past/stale, described in past tense - a recently_closed distractor within the same page, not a separate row.

title: Nuffield Farming Postgraduate Certificate
eligibility_summary: Exclusively available to current or past recipients of the Nuffield Farming scholarship. Delivered in partnership with IBERS, Aberystwyth University. Students register for two years and may join in January, May or September.
summary: A flexible, distance-learning 60-credit postgraduate certificate for Nuffield Farming scholars to write up their study/report in academic style; core Extended Project plus optional agri-food modules; assessed by coursework. Multiple intakes per year (Jan/May/Sep).
exclusion_reason: Restricted to current/past Nuffield Farming scholarship recipients only, so not available to UK-based researchers generally; also an educational course rather than a funding call/open opportunity.
notes: in_scope=no: this is a taught PG Cert course, not an open funding call; and it is 'exclusively available to current or past recipients of the Nuffield Farming scholarship' (restricted). No deadline/amount stated on the page (fees/bursary silent -> blank). Rolling intake (Jan/May/Sep). Included as a distractor per protocol. FLAG FOR REVIEW: borderline whether an academic-style credentialing course counts as an 'opportunity' at all - excluded on both the restricted-eligibility and not-a-call grounds.

title: Global Focus Programme (GFP)
eligibility_summary: Open to all new UK and International Scholars (i.e. those already selected onto a Nuffield scholarship). Applicants express an initial interest only, with no bearing on scholarship selection.
summary: A five-week intensive travel programme for new Scholars, travelling in small groups to ~seven countries to experience diverse agricultural systems; an add-on to a Scholar's own study travel with possible additional funding to be confirmed with the Director.
exclusion_reason: Not a standalone open call: available only to already-selected new UK/International Scholars, and is an expression-of-interest travel component of the main scholarship rather than a distinct fundable opportunity for UK-based researchers.
notes: in_scope=no distractor: the GFP is a component of the existing scholarship for 'all new UK and International Scholars', not a separate award applicants can win; 'Applicants are encouraged to express an initial interest, solely as an indication of numbers... no bearing or influence on the Scholarship selection process.'
